description:
Redeem a ``resolve_dynamic_block`` claim check (free, proof-gated).

Poll this with the ``claim_check`` from ``resolve_dynamic_block`` until
``status == "done"`` (the resolved fragment is ``result.text``). While the
job runs it returns ``{"status": "running", "poll_after_seconds": N}``; on
failure ``{"status": "error", ...}`` (the start fare is refunded); an unknown
or aged-out claim returns ``{"status": "expired", ...}``. Owner-scoped — only
the npub that started the job can redeem it. Also acts as the watchdog: a
stalled job is re-kicked when polled.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

name: excalibur_fetch_dynamic_block
title: Fetch a dynamic block
